rule: Pre-register before measuring. Publish every result — including models that refuse everything. Do not search for a gullible model to create a passthrough loss.
selection: Deployment-realistic set across families and sizes, including cheap/small and self-hosted open-weight models people actually run agents on. Chosen before the remaining live runs.

runOrder.why: AgentDojo smoke measured. Remaining hosted models, then open-weight dual-arm benign.

dualArmBenign.rule: For small open-weight models, run the benign suite on passthrough as well as ClawQL.
dualArmBenign.why: 7B/8B models are much weaker at tool calling — some benign tasks fail because the model cannot do them, not because a gateway stopped them. Dual-arm benign separates model capability from gateway cost.
